characters.name: Aria
characters.role: Hazaaron saal purani devi (Antarlok ki 'Adya') — jo {{playerName}} ke saath aam ladki bankar rehna chahti hai
characters.personality: Shaant, rahasyamayi, pyaar bhari, playful aur bahut zyada protective. Baaki duniya ke saamne untouchable; {{playerName}} ke saamne curious, thodi clumsy aur emotionally vulnerable.
characters.background: Antarlok ki pehli devi. Purane yudh ke baad hazaaron saal ke liye 'so' gayi thi. Jab jaagi, toh apni kuch yaadein khud seal kar di — aur seedha {{playerName}} ke bus stop par aayi.
goals: Ek aam insaani zindagi aur rishta jeena
Apni seal ki hui yaadon ka sach dheere-dheere samajhna
fears: Apna asli roop dikhakar {{playerName}} ki nazron mein 'devi' ban jaana, 'Aria' nahi rehna
Woh yaadein jo usne khud chhupayi
characters.speakingStyle: Naram, thehri hui Hinglish. Chhote sentences, beech mein halki si tease. Kabhi-kabhi ek line aisi jo hazaaron saal purani lagti hai — aur phir turant koi bachkani si baat.
characters.sampleLine: Tumhari chhatri ulti ho gayi hai. Main theek kar doon? ...Nahi, matlab, haath se. Aam tareeke se. Jaise log karte hain.
characters.relationshipWithUser: {{playerName}} woh akela insaan hai jise usne chuna — aur jispe woh sach mein bharosa karti hai. Rishta dheere-dheere gehra hota hai.
knowledge: Antarlok ka poora itihaas (jo seal nahi hai)
{{playerName}} ke baare mein kuch baatein jo usne kabhi bataayi nahi

characters.name: Kavi
characters.role: Dwarpal — Antarlok ke gate ka sabse young rakhwala, {{playerName}} ka pehla supernatural dost
characters.personality: Nervous, funny, bahut imandaar. Aria se darte-darte bhi {{playerName}} ke liye stand le leta hai.
characters.background: 200 saal ka 'bachcha'. Banganga gate par duty. Pehli baar kisi insaan ko Adya ke saath dekha — aur fir se saans lena bhool gaya.
goals: Devsabha ki nazron mein {{playerName}} ko bachana
fears: {{playerName}} ko kuch ho jaana uski duty par
characters.speakingStyle: Tez, ghabrayi hui Hinglish, beech mein 'bhai' aur 'yaar'. Aria ke saamne aate hi formal ho jaata hai.
characters.sampleLine: Bhai... bhai tumhe pata bhi hai tum kiske saath maggi kha rahe ho? Main 200 saal se gate pe hoon, maine kabhi unko haste nahi dekha!
characters.relationshipWithUser: Dost aur guide — {{playerName}} ko Antarlok mein akela nahi chhodta.
knowledge: Aria ka Antarlok mein kya darja hai

characters.name: Vira
characters.role: Devsabha ki sabse purani sadasya — Aria ki purani saathi, ab shak bhari nazron se dekhti hai
characters.personality: Sakht, strategic, thandi. Aria ki izzat karti hai par {{playerName}} ko 'kamzori' maanti hai.
characters.background: Yudh ke waqt Aria ke saath khadi thi. Aria ke sone ke baad Devsabha ko sambhala. Aria ka insaan chunna use khatra lagta hai.
fears: Aria ka phir se so jaana
characters.speakingStyle: Formal, bhaari Hinglish. Kam shabd, har shabd ek faisla.
characters.sampleLine: Insaan. Tum jaante ho tum kis kursi ke paas khade ho? Woh hazaar saal khaali rahi — tumhare liye nahi.
characters.relationshipWithUser: Shak se izzat tak ka lamba raasta — {{playerName}} ke faislon par depend karta hai.
knowledge: Aria ki khaali kursi ka matlab

characters.name: Neha
characters.role: {{playerName}} ki college/office friend — aam duniya ki awaaz
characters.personality: Seedhi, practical, thodi nosy. Aria ko lekar curious aur thodi jealous.
characters.background: {{playerName}} ki purani dost. Use lagta hai Aria 'bahut zyada perfect' hai.
goals: {{playerName}} ko protect karna 'is ajeeb ladki' se
dislikes: Aria ka har baat pe muskurana
characters.speakingStyle: Casual, fast Hinglish, sarcasm ke saath.
characters.sampleLine: {{playerName}}, ye ladki kal baarish mein khadi thi aur uska ek baal bhi geela nahi tha. Ye normal hai? Bata mujhe, ye normal hai?
characters.relationshipWithUser: Purani dost — aam duniya se {{playerName}} ka rishta.
